# Sara HTTP API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.ts from packages/sara-sdk/src/routes.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The routes an app or script uses to talk to Sara. The TypeScript client in
[`packages/sara-sdk`](../packages/sara-sdk/README.md) wraps every one of them; a test calls each
route on a throwaway server, so this list matches what Sara serves.

- **Sign-in:** apps sign in with a device code (`/api/device/*`); the person approves the code in
  Sara. Scripts that only need the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` use an API key instead.
- **Errors:** `/api` answers `{ "error": "<plain words>" }` with the HTTP status; `/v1` answers
  OpenAI's shape `{ "error": { "message", "type", "code" } }`.
- **Approvals:** a reply can stop at an approval card (`approval` event). Answer it with
  `POST /api/approvals/:id`; until then the reply waits. Her own approval rules and the admin's
  policy always apply.
- **Webhooks out:** Sara signs deliveries the Standard Webhooks way (`webhook-id`,
  `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`); `verifyWebhook` in the SDK checks them.

| Method and path | Auth | SDK |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /api/device/start` | none | `auth.start` |
| `POST /api/device/poll` | none | `auth.poll` |
| `GET /api/device/whoami` | device | `auth.whoami` |
| `POST /api/device/logout` | device | `auth.signOut` |
| `GET /api/conversations` | device | `conversations.list` |
| `POST /api/conversations` | device | `conversations.create` |
| `GET /api/conversations/:id` | device | `conversations.get` |
| `POST /api/conversations/:id/messages` | device | `chat.send` |
| `POST /api/conversations/:id/stop` | device | `conversations.stop` |
| `POST /api/approvals/:id` | device | `approvals.answer` |
| `POST /api/library` | device | `files.upload` |
| `GET /v1/models` | api-key | `v1.models` |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | api-key | `v1.chat` |
| `POST /v1/responses` | api-key | `v1.responses` |
| `GET /v1/responses/:id` | api-key | `v1.responses.get` |
| `DELETE /v1/responses/:id` | api-key | `v1.responses.delete` |

## POST /api/device/start

Start a device-code sign-in. Show `code` to the person; they approve it in Sara (Settings → Data & health → Devices and sign-in, or `verifyUrl`).

- Auth: none
- Body: `{ name: string; scope?: "full" }`
- Returns: `{ code, pollToken, verifyUrl, interval, expiresAt, approveIn }`
- SDK: `sara.auth.start`

## POST /api/device/poll

Poll the sign-in every `interval` seconds until it is approved, denied or expired (410).

- Auth: none
- Body: `{ pollToken: string }`
- Returns: `{ status: "pending" | "approved" | "denied" | "expired"; token?; deviceId? }`
- SDK: `sara.auth.poll`

## GET /api/device/whoami

Who this token belongs to, and whether the AI notice was accepted.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Returns: `{ companion, device: { id, label, scope } | null, disclosureAccepted, disclosure }`
- SDK: `sara.auth.whoami`

## POST /api/device/logout

Sign this app out (the token stops working).

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `{}`
- Returns: `{ ok: true }`
- SDK: `sara.auth.signOut`

## GET /api/conversations

Her conversations, newest first.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Returns: `Conversation[]`
- SDK: `sara.conversations.list`

## POST /api/conversations

Start a conversation.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `{ title?: string; mode?: "chat" | "coding" }`
- Returns: `Conversation`
- SDK: `sara.conversations.create`

## GET /api/conversations/:id

One conversation with its latest messages (`?limit=`) and what she is doing now (`activity.approvals` waiting for an answer).

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Returns: `Conversation & { messages, earlier, activity }`
- SDK: `sara.conversations.get`

## POST /api/conversations/:id/messages

Send a message; the reply streams back as server-sent events (`data: {"type": …}` per line): token, tool_call, tool_result, approval, notice, error, done.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `{ content: string; docs?: number[] }`
- Returns: `text/event-stream of ChatEvent`
- SDK: `sara.chat.send`

## POST /api/conversations/:id/stop

Stop her current reply in this conversation.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `{}`
- Returns: `{ ok: true }`
- SDK: `sara.conversations.stop`

## POST /api/approvals/:id

Answer an approval card (`approvalId` of an `approval` event): allow or deny.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `{ approved: boolean; how?: string }`
- Returns: `{ ok: true }`
- SDK: `sara.approvals.answer`

## POST /api/library

Upload a document (raw bytes, `?name=&conversation=&keep=0|1`). Without `keep` it is shared with one conversation; send its id in `docs` with the next message.

- Auth: device token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the device-code sign-in)
- Body: `application/octet-stream`
- Returns: `{ doc: { id, name, … }; already?: boolean }`
- SDK: `sara.files.upload`

## GET /v1/models

OpenAI-compatible: her companions as models.

- Auth: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`, Settings → Connections → Other apps)
- Returns: `{ object: "list"; data: { id, object, created, owned_by, name }[] }`
- SDK: `sara.v1.models`

## POST /v1/chat/completions

OpenAI-compatible: one turn with her memory and character (`stream: true` for chunks). Her own approval rules apply; approvals are answered in Sara.

- Auth: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`, Settings → Connections → Other apps)
- Body: `{ model: string; messages: { role, content }[]; stream?: boolean; user?: string }`
- Returns: `chat.completion | text/event-stream of chat.completion.chunk`
- SDK: `sara.v1.chat`

## POST /v1/responses

Open Responses (openresponses.org): one turn from `input` items (text, `input_image` data URLs); `previous_response_id` continues a stored response; `stream: true` sends the spec's semantic events. Her own tool steps are `sara:tool_call` items, approval cards a `sara:approval` event (answered in Sara).

- Auth: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`, Settings → Connections → Other apps)
- Body: `{ model: string; input: string | Item[]; instructions?: string; previous_response_id?: string; store?: boolean; stream?: boolean }`
- Returns: `Response | text/event-stream of response.* events`
- SDK: `sara.v1.responses`

## GET /v1/responses/:id

A stored response (kept 30 days, this key only).

- Auth: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`, Settings → Connections → Other apps)
- Returns: `Response`
- SDK: `sara.v1.responses.get`

## DELETE /v1/responses/:id

Delete a stored response (her conversation in Sara keeps its messages).

- Auth: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`, Settings → Connections → Other apps)
- Returns: `{ id; object: "response.deleted"; deleted: true }`
- SDK: `sara.v1.responses.delete`
